name: NIS2 Directive
description: EU Directive 2022/2555 — Network and Information Security measures for essential and important entities

controls.name: System hardening and vulnerability management
controls.desc: Mandatory access control, ASLR, SUID audit, and timely security patching as part of risk-based security policies.

controls.name: Network security controls
controls.desc: Firewall active, IP forwarding disabled, ICMP redirect protection, reverse path filtering, legacy SMBv1 and LLMNR disabled.

controls.name: Security patching
controls.desc: Available security updates are applied to address known vulnerabilities; auto-updates enabled where appropriate; reboots not pending.

controls.name: Logging and monitoring
controls.desc: Audit daemon active, logon events recorded, time synchronized for cross-host correlation, failed logins surfaced.

controls.name: Authentication and access hygiene
controls.desc: SSH hardened with key-based auth, root login disabled, brute-force protection, no duplicate UID 0, RDP NLA enforced.

controls.name: Cryptography and encryption
controls.desc: Strong TLS protocols enforced, weak ciphers disabled, certificates not expired, SMB signing required, data at rest encrypted.

controls.name: Access control and file permissions
controls.desc: No unauthorized root accounts, no world-writable system files, password hashes and shadow file protected, SSH access restricted.

controls.name: Secure authentication mechanisms
controls.desc: Public key authentication enabled, password auth disabled, X11 forwarding disabled, auto-login disabled.
